title: Student Management System
tagline: A console-based C application for managing student records with persistent file storage.
problem: I wanted to practice fundamental C programming concepts by building a real application instead of isolated exercises. The goal was to create a system capable of storing and managing student information while learning structures, arrays, modular programming, and file handling.

components.name: Structures
components.purpose: Store student information in a structured format.

components.name: Arrays
components.purpose: Manage multiple student records in memory.

components.name: File Handling
components.purpose: Save and load student data from storage.

components.name: Functions
components.purpose: Organize program logic into reusable modules.

timeline.title: Data Structure Design
timeline.desc: Designed the Student structure and planned how records would be stored.

timeline.title: Core CRUD Features
timeline.desc: Implemented add, view, search, update, and delete operations.

timeline.title: Persistent Storage
timeline.desc: Added file saving and loading functionality so records persist between sessions.

failures: Initially struggled with reading and writing structured data to files correctly.
Faced issues handling string input because of newline characters left in the input buffer.
Needed multiple revisions to ensure records were updated and deleted correctly.

reflections.what_worked: Using structures and modular functions made the project easier to maintain and extend.
reflections.what_failed: Input handling and file operations caused several bugs during development.
reflections.next_time: I would replace text-file storage with a database and build a graphical user interface.
